thread:
sam: deploy finished for eu1 svc-model-serve at 06:12 UTC. kicking off post-deploy smoke. quick note: seeing p95 uplift on synthetic embed/chat against model-variant v2-eu.

deploy-bot: deployment 2026-06-15_eu1_4567 completed. postdeploy summary: prefix-kv warmup OK, liveness OK, synthetic probes: 3/5 degraded (p95 +200ms). failing probes: embed-route, chat-route, tokenizer-check. (command: `deploy status 2026-06-15_eu1_4567`)

maria: digging into synth logs now. I'm seeing tokenizer deprecation warnings in container logs for v2-eu plus intermittent 503s during warmstart cycles.

kai: do we have any customer-facing error spike? prod error-rate stays low (<0.01%) but eu embed tail latency is elevated. not seeing 5xx storm.

oliver: replayed a few smokes against v2-eu locally — tokenizer falls back to a compatibility encoder on certain inputs which incurs ~170-200ms due to an extra re-encode. reproducible with long sequences.

sam: options on table: (1) alias-swap eu routing back to v1.4.2 (fast rollback), (2) pin traffic to a warm fallback pool while infra investigates, (3) attempt a hotfix to tokenizer config. thoughts? :thinking_face:

maria: alias-swap is fastest and low-risk; routing layer supports atomic alias updates. we can perform it in under 2 mins. rollback tested in staging earlier this week.

kai: +1 for alias-swap to minimize user-visible impact. after swap, run full synth suite and hold for one warmup window (~5m) before declaring stable.

deploy-bot: alias-swap queued by @sam: swap alias svc-model-serve.eu1 -> v1.4.2. Execute with: `deploy alias-swap --service svc-model-serve --region eu1 --target v1.4.2`

sam: executing alias-swap now.

deploy-bot: alias-swap job started (id: 9a8f). warming target variant with prefill and ramping traffic incrementally.

maria: running synth smoke against eu1 after swap. example command:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://eu1.api.redwood.ai/smoke -d '{"route":"embed","input":"redwood test long input to hit tokenizer fallback"}' | jq
```

oliver: redacted tokenizer debug excerpt:
```
[2026-06-15T06:15:02Z] tokenizer: fallback to legacy-encoder for seq>1024 (variant=v2-eu) -> +180ms
[2026-06-15T06:15:03Z] container: warmstart backoff 200ms x3
```

kai: synth run #1 post-swap: embed p95 improved from +200ms to +12ms. chat-route p95 normalized as well. no increase in 5xxs. recommending 10m watch.

sam: marking this as a partial rollback (eu alias-swap). I'll update the release notes and open an action item to root-cause the tokenizer fallback.

maria: created ticket INF-3421: investigate tokenizer fallback + warmstart behavior on v2-eu. assigned to @oliver.

oliver: ack, I'll reproduce, and if needed land a config fix. initial hunch: compatibility flag not read in this build.

escalations-bot: automatic alert suppressed (reason: alias-swap executed). auto-escalation cancelled.

kai: final check at +12m: metrics stable, no regressions observed. recommend resolving and closing watch.

sam: resolving from release side. follow-up: add a synthetic that exercises tokenizer deprecation path to the standard smoke suite.

oliver: will add unit/smoke test in tokenizer repo and include in CI. targeting next sprint PR.

sam: closing thread. thanks all :tada:
